crossRefs.note: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all…
“When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall…
Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the…

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”
translations.kjv: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
translations.asv: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also; for thou hast saved us out of the hand of Midian.
